# locale-lint

> Zero-config i18n linter for React Native, React & Next.js. Cross-references your
> source code against locale files to catch missing, extra, unused, and undefined
> translation keys, hardcoded strings, and interpolation mismatches. Runs in CI,
> no ESLint setup, not tied to one i18n library.

Install: `npm install --save-dev locale-lint` — or run directly with `npx locale-lint check`.

## Commands

- `npx locale-lint check`: run all checks (human-readable).
- `npx locale-lint check --json`: machine-readable output for CI/agents.
- `npx locale-lint init`: scaffold `locale-lint.config.json`.

Flags: `--src <dir>`, `--locales <dir>`, `--base <locale>`, `--ignore-unused`,
`--ignore-hardcoded`, `--json`.

Exit codes: `0` clean, `1` issues found, `2` fatal error.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): full usage, config, library support, comparison vs alternatives.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): when to run it, exit codes, and the `--json` output schema.
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): version history and migration notes.

## Checks

- Missing keys (in base, absent from a target locale)
- Extra keys (in a target locale, absent from base)
- Undefined keys (used in code, defined nowhere)
- Unused keys (defined, never used in code)
- Hardcoded strings (raw UI text not run through `t()`)
- Interpolation mismatches (variable sets differ across locales)

## Supported

react-i18next, next-intl (namespace-aware), i18next, i18n-js, react-intl/FormatJS,
vue-i18n. Locale formats: flat JSON, namespaced JSON dirs, TypeScript/JS modules.
